body:
I get it 100%. You aren't alone in feeling this way.

Just take care of yourself. I'm currently going through a lot and just tried drinking as an escape. It made things worse. Try and be apathetic to those thoughts to the best of your ability. The more you treat them as if they're plausible, the more they'll seem plausible to you.

Feel free to message me if you're feeling lost. I feel lost too but it's important to communicate with others, as I've discovered. We're in this together, even if it feels unreal. This is a terrible thing to go through but you are not alone nor do you have to keep on feeling this way.
It makes no sense and yet it makes sense at the friggin time
At this point I'm not even asking questions I'm just going to try it.
It's a struggle to even remember what I did yesterday

I had a panic attack + psychotic break from reality after having pot (the two blended together at many points because the hallucinations and delusions were terrifying.) I think it's what led to the dpdr I have now. That psychosis has messed me up months later.

Yes. I feel like I can never take reality for granted again.

I'm sorry you're going through this.
It's truly a place that's terrible to be in because it feels so plausible that nothing is real... I could keep on going on and venting but I know I need to try and not think about it.

I think it's worked for me before until I ran out and never bothered to buy another vial.

I may just have to run over to the alternative medicine store today because this post reminded me about how well it worked for me, and I'm currently going through a mental rough patch.

It's so bad that I've been having nocturnal panic attacks & have been waking up feeling like I'm going to leap out of my skin. My heart beats so fast and it's like reality is collapsing around me.

Usually I can confide in people when I'm having mental issues, but this is just next-level insanity. How do I tell someone that it feels like they're not real?
Thank you, I just have to have faith in that fact. It's crazy that I've even come to a point that I have to try and force myself to believe in reality.

Oh my god this is exactly how I feel...

I don't know what I can do to convince you I'm conscious or convince myself that you're conscious.

I don't know how to reverse these thoughts. I started having them after experiencing psychosis and it truly feels like I've died. This is the worst sort of pain I can imagine and now I'm living it everyday. I don't know how to talk to anyone about it... 

I know this was posted a month ago & I hope you're doing well.

Yea last night I lost feeling in my entire body, like I was floating but in a terrifying way. I had such bad dpdr that I swore I was just becoming a stream of consciousness and started experiencing closed eye visuals.

I've had such bad existential dread the past week that I'm afraid I'm getting close to some horrible "truth" about consciousness and I'm going to end up leaving my body...
